title: Fixed-degree pure-tensor coface equation
statement: For fixed n and j, the normalized singleton tensor comparison commutes with the j-th coface on a pure tensor.

proof.text: Express tprod(b) as the product of singleAlgHom(k)(b(k)), using tprod_prod and univ_prod_mulSingle. Apply the already proved amitsurMap_comp_singleAlgHom to every factor. The resulting product of single factors is tprod(j.insertNth 1 b), checked at j and j.succAbove(k). This is the fully proved private amitsurMap_tprod helper.

Use amitsurCosimplicialObject_δ_hom and LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, then the preceding insertion equation. Forget scalars and apply ULift to obtain hr: the lifted Amitsur coface sends the given pure tensor to the explicit inserted-unit pure tensor.

Evaluate both composites as functions and rewrite the Amitsur-side argument using hr. Apply the geometric normalized Čech coface theorem to (e n).hom and (e (n+1)).hom. The supplied he n and he (n+1) are exactly its hom-normalization hypotheses by definition. This completes the unchanged target equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor identification: algebraic insertion proved from the existing Amitsur implementation; geometric restriction step isolated in lem-sc-singleton-tensor-cech-normalized-coface.

theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparison_pure_coface_fixed
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (he : ∀ n, IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n (e n))
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
      (m : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤))
      (b : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ((e n).hom ≫ (singletonTensorCechCosimplicial X F U W g).δ j)
        (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b)) =
      ((singletonTensorForget U.left).map
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurCosimplicialObject Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤)
          Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)).δ j) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom)
            (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b))
